# software-rasterizer

Rasterize triangles on the CPU with a top-left fill rule, z-buffer, perspective-correct texturing, Lambert lighting, OBJ loading and tolerance-based image comparison C++20 library `software-rasterizer`.

- [README](README.md): Problem, installation, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Library components and API
